create_cargo_dispatch.config.detector.ra: Horizontal (XZ-plane) scan radius for cargo detectors, in blocks. Default 16, range 1 ~ 64.
Vertical (Y-axis) scan radius for cargo detectors, in blocks. Default 4, range 1 ~ 32.
Vertical (Y-axis) offset of the whole detection volume: positive moves it up, negative moves it down, in blocks. Default 4 (the detector level becomes the bottom), range -32 ~ 32.
create_cargo_dispatch.config.orders.max_: Maximum pending orders that can exist simultaneously for each origin station type. No new auto-generated orders once the cap is reached until players accept some. Default 12, range 1 ~ 100.
create_cargo_dispatch.config.orders.refr: Minimum interval between random order refreshes. 20 ticks = 1 second. Default 6000 (5 min), range 200 ~ 72000 (1 hour).
Maximum interval between random order refreshes. Actual interval = random(min, max). Default 12000 (10 min), range 600 ~ 144000 (2 hours).
create_cargo_dispatch.config.orders.expi: Minimum time a PENDING order will remain before auto-expiring. 20 ticks = 1 second. Default 18000 (15 min).
Maximum time a PENDING order will remain before auto-expiring. Actual expire = createdTick + random(min,max). Default 24000 (20 min). Setting both min and max to 0 disables expiry.
How often the server scans PENDING_ORDERS for expired entries. Smaller = more precise but more CPU. Default 100 (≈5s). Recommended 100~400.
create_cargo_dispatch.config.reward.lumb: Fixed freight coins per lumber yard order. Default 20; deposited into the company account on completion.
Extra freight coins per cargo item (decimal). Default 0.10.
Distance is the main payout factor: distance coins = straight-line distance × this value. Default 0.50 (1 coin per 2 blocks); long hauls pay far more.
Maximum freight coins for a single lumber yard order (base + per-cargo + distance). Default 8000.
create_cargo_dispatch.config.reward.mine: Fixed freight coins per mine order. Default 30.
Extra freight coins per mine cargo item (decimal). Default 0.15.
Distance is the main payout factor; mine long hauls pay a higher rate. Default 0.60.
Mine order freight coin cap. Default 12000.
create_cargo_dispatch.config.reward.farm: Fixed freight coins per farm order. Default 20.
Extra freight coins per farm cargo item (decimal). Default 0.10.
Distance is the main payout factor. Default 0.50.
Farm order freight coin cap. Default 10000.
create_cargo_dispatch.config.reward.past: Fixed freight coins per pasture order. Default 25.
Extra freight coins per pasture cargo item (decimal). Default 0.12.
Distance is the main payout factor. Default 0.55.
Pasture order freight coin cap. Default 10000.
create_cargo_dispatch.config.reward.meta: Fixed freight coins per metallurgy order. Default 40.
Extra freight coins per metallurgy cargo item (decimal). Default 0.20.
Distance is the main payout factor; metallurgy has the highest long-haul rate. Default 0.70.
Metallurgy order freight coin cap. Default 16000.
create_cargo_dispatch.config.progression: Reputation gained on order completion = max(minimum per order, round(coins × this value)). Default 0.5.
Even short hauls grant at least this much reputation, so progression never stalls. Default 10.
Stations a company can link at reputation level 1. Default 2.
Additional stations that can be linked for each reputation level gained. Default 1.
Cost to reach the next company level = base × current level². Default 500 (1→2 costs 500, 2→3 costs 2000, 3→4 costs 4500, 4→5 costs 8000 coins).
create_cargo_dispatch.config.notificatio: Server-wide master switch: whether to push new-order notification sounds to all players. Enabled by default. When disabled, no player receives the sound (per-player/per-station control via the bell button on connected stations).

Server-wide master switch: whether to send new-order chat messages to all players. Enabled by default. When disabled, no player receives the chat message (per-player/per-station control via the bell button on connected stations).
Clicking the origin coordinates in the new-order chat message automatically adds a Xaero Minimap waypoint (named "Origin #orderId"). Disable to ignore clicks.
Automatically delete an order's Xaero waypoint once the player moves within its remove radius. Enabled by default.
Distance in blocks within which a waypoint is considered "arrived" and auto-removed. Default 16, range 1 ~ 256.
Volume for new-order and similar notification sounds. 0.0 = silent, 1.0 = full master volume. Default 0.8.
